methodologyNotes: Covers consumer meat/cooking thermometers sold at a published US MSRP: handheld instant-read probes, wired leave-in probe units, and fully wireless smart probes. Excludes non-food infrared surface thermometers, laboratory/industrial thermocouples, and integrated appliance sensors. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. probeType is an enum: instant-read (handheld, cannot stay in food), leave-in-wired (probe on a cable to a base unit), or wireless-probe (self-contained probe reporting over radio). tempRangeFahrenheit is the rated food/probe measurement range in degrees F as 'low to high'. accuracyFahrenheit is the manufacturer's rated accuracy as a plus/minus value in degrees F within the key cooking range; lower is better. responseTimeSec is the rated time to a stable reading in seconds for instant-read units; null for leave-in and wireless probes that monitor continuously. numProbes is the count of temperature probes included in the box. connectivity is an enum: none, bluetooth, wifi, rf, or bluetooth-wifi. wirelessRangeFt is the manufacturer-rated line-of-sight wireless range in feet; 0 for wired-only or non-connected units. waterResistanceRating is the published ingress-protection rating string (e.g. IP67, IP65, IPX4) or 'none' if undisclosed. batteryLifeHrs is the rated battery life in hours; null if not disclosed. displayType is an enum: lcd, oled, led, rotating-lcd, or app-only (no on-device display). weightGrams is the device (or probe, for wireless) weight in grams.
